## Professional Profile

I am pursuing an **M.Sc. in Management and Digital Technology at the Technical University of Munich, Campus Heilbronn**. My experience includes supply-chain strategy and data analytics at Mercedes-Benz, alongside finance, controlling, and the implementation of digital business systems.

My focus is connecting business processes with data, automation, and modern digital technologies.
